source.subject: The Golden Ticket #87: Events to book right now
source.label: Golden Ticket #87

events.title: Young Archaeologists' Club (YAC)
events.when: 24 October 2026 to 13 March 2027, select dates only (24 Oct, 21 Nov, 16 Jan, 13 Feb, 13 Mar), all start at 10:30
events.blurb: Hands-on archaeology sessions for 8 to 16s, including a trip to a Roman bathhouse.

events.title: Ballroom Boogie x Toasty Tots XL
events.blurb: A free family dance party for 5 to 11s and their grown-ups in the Clore Ballroom.

events.title: Diwali Mela at Kricket Canary Wharf
events.address: Unit 6 Frobisher Passage, Canary Wharf Estate
events.blurb: A Diwali family day with screen printing, carrom, henna and bottomless biryani.

events.title: Bones in the Desert
events.blurb: A new play about a young refugee and a century-old story, with a Q&A afterwards.

events.title: The Jungle Book
events.when: 13 November 2026 to 6 February 2027, Monday–Saturday at 19:00, matinees on Wednesdays and Saturdays
events.blurb: A new Olivier stage adaptation with inventive puppetry, set in the Sundarbans.

events.title: A Tale of Us
events.when: 20 and 21 November 2026, Friday 10:30, 12:00 and 14:00, Saturday 11:00, 13:00 and 15:00
events.blurb: A multi-sensory show for new parents and babies, followed by a stay and play.

events.title: The Three Little Wolves
events.when: 28 November 2026 to 7 February 2027, various dates and start times (see website)
events.blurb: A glove puppet musical on a barge, 50 minutes with no interval.

events.title: Pinocchio
events.when: 28 November 2026 to 3 January 2027, various times (see website)
events.blurb: A musical retelling of Pinocchio with live music, returning to the Globe.

events.title: A Christmas Carol performed by James Swanton
events.price: £29 per person (includes same-day museum entry before the show)
events.blurb: A one-man Christmas Carol inside Dickens’s only surviving London home.

events.title: Winter at the Wetlands
events.address: Engine House Visitor Centre, 2 Forest Road
events.price: Adults and child bundle £36, additional child £20.70, additional adult £18
events.blurb: A Christmas show with Santa and a gift for every child, in a nature reserve.
